description: This file defines the VacancyAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It uses Doctrine ORM to map class properties to database columns, representing attachments associated with job vacancies, including file content, metadata, and relations to Vacancy entities.

classes.name: VacancyAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a vacancy attachment, including properties for file data, metadata, and relations, with ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy entity with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the binary content of the file.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the binary content of the file.

methods.name: getAttachmentType
methods.description: Returns the type of the attachment, if specified.

methods.name: setAttachmentType
methods.description: Sets the type of the attachment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the attachment.
